author: native_center_owner

reviewMethod.sourceRead: Complete new production modules, contract, migration, new test/fixture, all changed direct-consumer product/test deltas and relevant existing transaction/auth/profile/admission/validity paths.
reviewMethod.skillsApplication: Reuse local discovery; inspect one state authority, interface/lifecycle bounds, transaction ownership, dependency direction and evidence scope. No install.

confirmedInvariants: Owner-only finite v1 authority fixes graph/node/input/predecessor/profile and exact external accepted bindings; <=20 nodes, <=64KiB, <=24h, hard admission count. Old node/tool grants gain no permission.

Candidate rotation commits before project locking. Advancement and revoke use project then progression; selected task rows are locked in deterministic ID order. Profile lookup adds no reverse project-to-runner lock; claim-time authority remains responsible for post-admission runner revocation.

Existing executeGoalNode/acceptTask/PgBoss wake and unique progression execution link commit in one transaction. Failed link insert rolls back admission. Repeated/concurrent sweep follows committed link rather than resubmitting.

Unknown, failed, cancel-requested, verification failure, input/knowledge/graph drift, exhausted admission and expiry halt new work. Revoke stops admission only, without claiming current task stopped. Genuine pending decision remains task-owned.

Within-progression qualification requires same stored grant link, current actual input/knowledge/dependencies, latest execution and current-attempt artifact, succeeded task and passed verifier. External dependencies still require actual owner acceptance. No caller qualified flag.

Legacy manual dependencies and explicit acceptance remain distinct. The shared resolver preserves admitted provenance without writing acceptance and invalidates downstream currentness on relevant producer changes. Old artifact detail remains readable.
Memoization lives only in one read resolver, keyed by execution object. The bounded DAG probe and fresh-read invalidation evidence do not claim global latency or throughput improvement.
Read routes use real existing owner authentication; new module owns no timer. Migration/source/export/factory automatic scan integration is explicitly outside this approval.

workCount.interpretation: Local repeated operational-status access count; not a system performance benchmark.

approvalBoundary: Module, explicit bounded sweep, real HTTP/PostgreSQL and real adapter/runtime with injected SDK transport; no real provider or natural-language planning claim.

Production factory migration/mount, automatic lifecycle scanning and shutdown/maintenance integration require the separate F01 change and direct-consumer validation. The current module fixture mounts its own routes explicitly.
Application-instance restart and persisted transaction outcomes were demonstrated; no OS hard-kill/power-loss claim.
Same-authorization mechanical qualification and separate owner acceptance are supported; bounded SDK limits are configured requests, not measured billing or semantic goal acceptance.
Existing snapshot material bounds/internal full-state reads remain; the new provenance projection is explicitly bounded at400 manifests and8000 links and does not read artifact bodies.
metadataNote: Canonical owner may update stale TODO evidence cells in status while recording this review; implementation approval target must remain the fixed source SHA.
